title: Watch: Read Your Soil
scope: Guided illustrative observation, not a soil-health diagnosis or measured soil profile. No simulated growth or infiltration.

scenes.label: Look at the soil
scenes.narration: Look closely at these two soil examples.

scenes.label: Soil structure
scenes.narration: First, look at soil structure. In the field, feel how a moist piece breaks apart.

scenes.label: Roots and spaces
scenes.narration: Look at the roots and the spaces around them.

scenes.label: Surface cover
scenes.narration: Look at the surface cover. Loose mulch covers one example.

scenes.label: Use several clues
scenes.narration: Use several clues together. Colour alone cannot tell you soil health. Check moisture, plant growth and how water enters the ground.
